desc:
🗺️ Dive in and soar the skies riding your favourite fire-breathing beasts from the many fantasy worlds that you love. Fight amongst friends in alliances or go solo against other players in game to claim rewards and unlock new dragons.

📱💻 This game is compatible with all Roblox supported platforms excluding VR.

Realm of Beasts is currently in BETA stages so do expect bugs and glitches, but we remain actively working to improve. 
👾 Feel free to join our community in order to report bugs and keep up with our latest reveals / updates!

💗 Please be sure to Favourite, Follow, and Like the game if you enjoyed this experience.

PC Controls:
V - Call dragon
C - Run
E - Mount dragon
X - Take off & Landing
F - Fire

Xbox Controls:
B - Call dragon
Y - Mount dragon
L1 - Take off & Landing
L2 - Run
R2 - Fire
